decision: split the spec into 8 tickets, spike on @pierre/diffs first
why: how it renders in Node decides the render stage, so it is the riskiest unknown

decision: set up a local git repo with no remote
why: no GitHub repo yet; commits give each ticket a reviewable diff

decision: '@pierre/diffs pre-renders in Node via preloadPatchDiff, with annotations as slot children
why: had to know before designing the render stage
evidence: docs/spikes/pierre-diffs.md; checked report.html: 63249 bytes, 0 scripts, 2 annotation slots; read screenshot

decision: client-side React diff costs about 1.5 MB raw against 63 KB pre-rendered, so ship no diff JS
why: the subagent measured both with esbuild

decision: proposed rendering the whole report to static HTML in Node instead of a client-rendered Vite template
why: declarative shadow DOM only applies when parsed as initial HTML, so client React injection fights the diff output
